timing_contract: Fresh sequential processes; complete original model geometry; full trace, validation, archival, publication and cleanup. Imports, installation and output hashing excluded.
limits: The complete 100-step command and concurrent peak memory are not repeated.
The 16-step comparison is one pair, and the sample does not characterize a timing distribution.
Custom scheduler private-state mutation and unsupported typed inputs require the reference implementation.
The two profiler runs are excluded from normal wall-time comparisons.
decision: Keep native queues optional; measured complete-run gain is below the 2x adoption gate.
